Everglades Bicycle Club Saturday Ride

Coral Gables, FL · Road

Everglades Bicycle Club Saturday Ride is a road group ride in Coral Gables, FL. It rolls every Saturday at 7:00 am from Ponce de Leon Middle School. About 20–60 miles, a/B/C groups.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 7:00 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: a/B/C groups. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Everglades Bicycle Club Saturday Ride group ride

Miami's oldest road club. Saturday training rides leave the middle school across from UM in several pace groups. New riders are asked to read the ride guide first and sit at the back on their first ride. The club also runs a short beginner ride on the second Saturday.
